Choosing the mechanism and identifying the domain are different questions.

title: A skill learns where it applies, from executed observations, in five of them

traps_hit_while_prototyping.how_it_is_pinned: a non-firing costs an observation and yields no evidence; not_applicable is a load-bearing count
traps_hit_while_prototyping.trap: a victim the skill never fires on counted as a failure
traps_hit_while_prototyping.why_it_is_wrong: NOT_APPLICABLE yields no observation: nothing was tried and nothing was learned. Counting it builds a boundary out of the tokenizer's reach instead of the skill's domain -- the same error as counting a PASS that only proved a process started.

traps_hit_while_prototyping.how_it_is_pinned: site facts follow the node, not the keyword; an if/while that merely CONTAINS the comparison is not a guard on it
traps_hit_while_prototyping.why_it_is_wrong: true of a function whose return is nowhere near the operator. Measured effect: the law identified {baseline.violates_own_spec, site.return} -- plausible, wrong, and narrower than the truth. On the AST the same evidence yields {baseline.violates_own_spec} alone. A crude extractor does not fail loudly; it reports a scope that looks identified.

traps_hit_while_prototyping.how_it_is_pinned: the ladder: three successes buy nothing, the first failure changes the answer, one more closes it
traps_hit_while_prototyping.trap: record states instead of counts, and stop there
traps_hit_while_prototyping.why_it_is_wrong: from a single before/after pair learn() returns AMBIGUOUS with 3 to 6 survivors, and select_contrast over observed states returns NO_REACHABLE_STATE_SPLITS_THE_SURVIVORS. States are necessary and not sufficient without contrasting observations on untaught victims.

what_is_not: that the acquired condition is TRUE in general: it is the one requirement consistent with the observations made, and learn refuses or returns AMBIGUOUS when the evidence does not support one
that the shipped corpus now has scopes: it does not. Acquiring one needs victims and a specification for each and neither is stored with a skill, so 5 shipped skills remain EXACT_MATCH_ONLY
that admits accepts anything: it decides whether a skill may be PROPOSED; the caller's verifier still decides the outcome, and the module exposes no apply/accept/commit/store/save surface
that a fact absent from a state was observed false: absent means not observed true

that this is model training or that model training is unnecessary in general: SkillOpt trained skill documents for a frozen agent and was best or tied-best on 52 of 52 cells with no weight updates, which is evidence against (1) being a prerequisite, not evidence that any gate is optional -- Skill-V measured Acquisition Only 68.80 against Static Library 73.40 and Full 95.30, so accumulating experience without a falsifiability gate is worse than not learning at all
that cross-domain transfer was attempted: it was not, and no claim is made about it
what_is_real: the same skill, executed against eight victims' own specifications, repairs 5 and breaks correct code on 3
its condition of applicability is bought in 5 observations and is ('baseline.violates_own_spec',) with 1 survivor
enforcing that scope takes breakages 3 -> 0 with repairs unchanged at 5, through refusals issued before any edit, each naming the missing fact and the breakage it prevented
the ladder is a dose-response: 3 successes UNDETERMINED, first failure AMBIGUOUS, fifth observation IDENTIFIED
with the failures deleted the same code refuses to name any requirement, so the label is earned
the law used is the tree's own applicability_v1.learn, pinned by a test so a private learner cannot drift from it
